summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for VoiceShield AI, an offline-first Android call screening and AI voice receptionist application covering real Android Telecom services, interactive call simulation, Sherpa-ONNX local voice model management with Android offline TTS fallback, 12-mood expressive voice synthesis, 24+ DataStore settings, AES-GCM encrypted voice message storage in Room, and a 12-screen Cyber-Security Shield Material 3 interface.
